method: Qualitative review of fifteen products through their publishers' documentation or official repositories. Observations are paraphrased; applications are our design decisions. This is a navigation and presentation review, not an engineering standard, commercial integration or product endorsement.

products.title: About Autodesk Docs
products.observed: Project information is organised through files, reviews, issues and reports, with structured folders and version control.
products.application: Keep project hubs separate from the source and export library; make the project context visible on every page.
products.where: Project hubs, breadcrumbs and Sources & exports
products.limit: Only the information architecture is adapted. No Autodesk connection or approval workflow is added.

products.title: Document Management
products.observed: A central document repository uses metadata such as status, type and discipline to organise and retrieve records.
products.application: Add project and document-type filters to the page directory and export library.
products.limit: Static filters do not provide Procore's permissions, review automation or audit services.

products.title: Folder structure and folder permissions
products.observed: Files live in a project folder hierarchy; revisions and links between documents and building models retain context.
products.application: Group by project before presenting drawings, quotations and versions. Retain existing addresses and files.
products.where: Grouped workspace navigation and project links
products.limit: No folder permission or new document revision system is implied.

products.title: List View
products.observed: File lists distinguish folders from files and expose attributes and filters rather than relying on thumbnails alone.
products.application: Offer compact, searchable lists beside the visual project overview, showing each item's project and format.
products.limit: File dates and live cloud synchronisation are not invented.

products.title: Get started with BIMcollab Model WebViewer
products.observed: Navigation, properties, issues/documents and lists are distinct panels around the model.
products.application: Keep drawing workspaces, quantities and review notes separately labelled, reachable through a page contents list.
products.where: Contents navigation and project task groups
products.limit: Existing viewers are preserved; model validation and issue pins are not newly implemented.

products.title: Visualization overview
products.observed: The viewer separates selection, measurement and clipping tools from a tree view, property grid and contextual status.
products.application: Keep global website navigation away from local drawing tools and preserve the selected work's own inspector.
products.limit: No new measurement accuracy or iTwin integration is claimed.

products.title: New Speckle web interface (Beta) is available
products.observed: The workspace overview leads to project pages; each model has a hub that retains version history and related information.
products.application: Put the two building/interior projects on the homepage and make version history a project-level destination.
products.where: Workspace home, Paila hub and Basanti hub
products.limit: The reviewed interface was a beta announcement. Only its documented hierarchy informs this design.

products.title: xeokit-bim-viewer documentation
products.observed: A browser model viewer separates object, class, storey and property views, with 2D and 3D viewing modes.
products.application: Use explicit labels for drawings, models, material tables and programmes; provide direct links rather than ambiguous version numbers alone.
products.limit: xeokit code is not installed or copied. Existing renderers and geometry remain in use.

products.title: BIM UI Components
products.observed: Reusable panels, toolbars, tables and input components are separated from model functionality.
products.application: Keep the shared website shell independent of project calculations, data and viewer controllers.
products.where: Shared organisation module and scoped interface styles
products.limit: This is a structural design analogy; no That Open package or copied component is introduced.

products.title: Interface
products.observed: The interface distinguishes an outliner, model viewport, properties, topbar and status information.
products.application: Give each page clear navigation, content and supporting-record zones, with visual separation and consistent headings.
products.where: Page layout, contents and supporting records
products.limit: The reviewed page belongs to the unstable documentation channel; it is used for layout concepts only.

products.title: BIM Workbench
products.observed: Building information can be grouped by sites, buildings and levels, and the same model supports drawings and quantity schedules.
products.application: Organise by project first and retain each project's shared source for its derived drawings, tables and schedules.
products.limit: This official documentation repository is archived. It supports an architectural pattern, not a claim about the latest FreeCAD release.

products.title: Work packages
products.observed: Identified work packages can be presented as tables, details and timeline views, with status and hierarchy.
products.application: Make programmes explicit project destinations while keeping quantities, work identifiers and existing schedules together.
products.where: Programme shortcuts and task-based project navigation
products.limit: Existing schedule calculations are retained; no collaboration server is added.

products.title: GanttProject official README
products.observed: Task hierarchy, dependencies, milestones, resource loading and exports are distinct but related project-planning functions.
products.application: Link to existing Gantt and resource views from the project hubs, and keep their exports beside their owning project.
products.where: Paila and Basanti programme links, export groups
products.limit: No dates, productivity assumptions or resource limits are changed by this redesign.

products.title: Getting Around and Finding Content
products.observed: A content hierarchy is supported by an ordered sidebar, breadcrumbs, search and sibling navigation.
products.application: Provide a grouped workspace sidebar, breadcrumbs, searchable page directory and relevant sibling links.
products.where: Global shell, directory and related-page navigation
products.limit: There is no BookStack backend; the catalogue is generated from the published site.

products.title: Sidebar
products.observed: Related pages are grouped in an ordered tree with a consistent shared sidebar and sibling navigation.
products.application: Use one navigation register and automatically generate local contents from the page's real headings.
products.where: Workspace navigation, page contents and page index
products.limit: Docusaurus is a reference, not the site's new framework; historical version URLs are retained.
